en: Colored lithographic view over a small European town nestled in a valley with forested hills and vineyards in the background. The foreground shows streets lined with 19th‑century houses and public buildings, with a few pedestrians. Church towers are visible among dense trees in the middle distance. The style is typical of late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century German picture postcards. Text in German appears at the bottom and top of the image.
